data.notes: Search budget (20) used. Passat Alltrack and Tiguan Allspace treated as separate nameplates and skipped. Where only ADAC data was available, confidence set to medium.

corrections.evidence: ADAC Passat Variant 2.0 TDI SCR BMT Highline 4MOTION DSG (10/14-07/18): 'Kofferraumvolumen normal 650 l'. Same in other B8 Variant 4MOTION entries (245086, 241920, 245088, 248391) and auto-data.net 2.0 TSI 280 PS 4MOTION (650-1780 l). B8 4MOTION has no trunk penalty, unlike B6/B7.
ADAC B8 Variant 4MOTION entries: 'Kofferraumvolumen dachhoch mit umgeklappter Rücksitzbank 1780 l'.

ADAC Passat Variant 2.0 TDI Trendline 4MOTION (05/06-02/08): 'Kofferraumvolumen normal 588 l'; same in 204670, 213432, 216607, 216613 (2.0 TDI DPF 4MOTION through 10/10) and R36 Variant 4MOTION (219170).
ADAC B6 Variant 2.0 TDI 4MOTION: 'Kofferraumvolumen dachhoch mit umgeklappter Rücksitzbank 1716 l'.

ADAC Passat Variant 1.4 TSI EcoFuel Trendline (Erdgasbetrieb) (01/09-10/10): normal 523 l; same for Comfortline/Highline entries (217513, 217536). kfz-auskunft road test: gas tanks reduce trunk by ~80 l to ~525 l.
ADAC B6 Variant 1.4 TSI EcoFuel entries: max. with rear seat folded 1651 l.

ADAC Passat Variant B7 entries list 'Höhe 1516 mm' (also vehiclesizes.com 1508-1516 mm, angurten.de 1508 mm). Caveat: likely includes roof rails (cf. B8 1477 vs 1516 mm with rails); no VW figure without rails found.

missing.detail: B6 R36 Variant 4MOTION (300 PS, 2008-2010): ADAC 588/1716 l (https://www.adac.de/rund-ums-fahrzeug/autokatalog/marken-modelle/vw/passat/b6/219170).
B8 2.0 TSI 4MOTION (220/280 PS) petrol AWD variant not listed; 650/1780 l per auto-data.net / ADAC 248391.
Polo IV 9N3 GTI (1.8T, 150 PS, 2006-2009) not listed; Parkers gives 3916 x 1650 mm; trunk-specific figure not found (series 270-1030 l).
Polo V pre-facelift GTI (180 PS, 2010-2014) only mentioned in notes; and Polo IV 9N pre-facelift (sold until ~03-04/2005) not covered.

verification.notes: Confirmed: B8 4767/1832/1477/2791, 650/1780, GTE 483/1613 (VW owner page volkswagen.de passat-b8, ams, ADAC); B7 4771/1820/2712, 603/1731, 4MOTION 588/1716, EcoFuel 523/1651; B6 4774/1517/2709, 603/1731; Polo V 3970/1682/1462, 280/952 (dewiki gives height range 1452-1485); Polo IV 9N3 3916/1650/1467/2466, 270/1030 (VW newsroom); Tiguan FL 4426/1703, 470/1510; Tiguan pre-FL 4427/1809/1686/2604, 470 l (cars-data; some sources 1683 mm height). 18 searches used.
